descriptions.description: A warm, natural Colombian woman in her late thirties who owns a small restaurant, speaking to another restaurant owner like a friend over coffee. Friendly Latin American Spanish with a subtle Colombian accent, conversational and playful, a little ironic when complaining, genuinely relieved and happy when sharing the solution. Realistic human phrasing, not a commercial announcer. Overall: de dueña a dueña: arranca cómplice y con ironía sobre la carta tachada, se cansa un poco en el PDF, se ilumina con alivio cuando aparece Tastora, baja a confidencial en '¿y cuánto cuesta?', explota de alegría en 'nada', y el payoff es satisfacción tranquila y clara. Performance arc, sentence by sentence: 1) dry, ironic and playful, a knowing half-smile; 2) dry, ironic and playful, a knowing half-smile. Realistic human phrasing with natural pauses at ellipses and line breaks, varied pitch and pace, never monotone, never theatrical.
